tips.text: Charge is on a long ~37s cooldown -- play aggressively against him whenever it's down.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Hook doesn't go through troopers; stand behind them to block it, or carry Reactive Barrier if you don't trust your dodge.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Rebuttal punishes his light-melee spam combos thanks to its low parry cooldown.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Keep your distance -- if she can't land Leaping Slash her lane presence is weak. Avoid tight spaces like the veil against her.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Play either very close or very far from him so his doorbells are hard to land; standing right in front of a thrown doorbell can block it.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Stay outside his gun's hard falloff range; buy Close Quarters if you're forced to fight him up close.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Take cover after his shockwave hits you to avoid the follow-up fire-rate slow/bonus damage. He's generally weak with a big hitbox -- poke him constantly.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Use cover or the veil to dodge his arrows. He's squishy, so consider diving him if he pushes up.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Avoid prolonged trades once her fixation stacks are high on you -- take short trades and let stacks decay instead.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Move unpredictably and crouch to dodge her headshots; carry a defensive barrier item for her ultimate.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Avoid open ground so he can't easily land afterburn; use height and wall jumps to dodge Flame Dash.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Force her to burn Stone Form (long cooldown), then punish the ~40s window it's down. Her head hitbox is large for headshots.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Stay one dash away from cover -- his Arctic Beam ramps up the longer it's on you.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Position on the opposite side of high ground so you keep vision of him without being hit by Ground Strike.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't stand bunched with your troopers -- poke from off angles so he has to choose between you and them.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Focus denies (her bullet velocity is weak). When she shields herself or an ally, shoot the other target or disengage.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't hide behind obvious cover when she charges Carbine -- she'll bomb you out of it. Use veils or unpredictable positioning instead.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Focus spirit damage on him -- he starts with -15% spirit resistance.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Aim for headshots (big hitbox, only 25% reduction from his hat). Don't stand beside your trooper when his Power Surge is active.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: His knives refresh stack duration when chained -- hide out after getting hit until the damage fully stops.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Dodge his bolt with stamina right after he redirects it, at the last second.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Focus his lane partner instead -- shooting Victor just charges his Pain Battery.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Watch for the Stake + Flight combo. Stay near cover while your wave is airborne; play aggressive when Flight/Stake are both down.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Learn to parry Puddle Punch with Rebuttal -- it reflects damage and heals you.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Fight her at range (bad weapon falloff/spread). Keep your HP above half -- Lethal Venom kills fast once you're low.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Keep 2 stamina banked (buy Extra Stamina if you start with less) to escape his cage.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Avoid standing in the open -- her card-charge is faster on heroes than troopers and hits hard once she's got souls + Quicksilver Reload.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Avoid close-range trades (she wins with Crimson Slash) -- poke at range and punish her during Power Slash's windup.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Learn dash jumping: dash, then jump right as your stamina bar flashes blue.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Crouch off ziplines instead of jumping off -- it preserves your momentum.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Slide whenever you can -- it gives extra speed and infinite ammo.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Wall jump near any wall for a free momentum boost with no stamina cost.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Mantle-glide every ledge: mantle, then hold crouch.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Memorize vent locations on the map to speed up rotations.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Save stamina before a fight so you can chase or escape.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Use secret-shop teleporters to move around quickly, especially early game.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Instant air dash (dash immediately after jumping) avoids the momentum loss of a normal ground-to-air transition.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Air strafe while airborne (A/D + mouse movement) for extra speed -- don't hold W in the air, it does nothing.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Bunny hop (jump the instant you land) to keep your air-strafe velocity between jumps.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Corner boost: air-strafe into a wall corner to launch upward instead of sideways, buying extra air-strafe time.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Edge boost: wall-jump forward off a nearby wall to go straight ahead instead of being redirected -- good for quick escapes.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Learn specific map rollouts (bridge-buff corner boost, mid boss roof jump, vent wall jump) to move between key spots faster.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Prioritize pushing and clearing trooper waves -- they're your most consistent soul source.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Learn camp/buff spawn timings so you can plan farm routes around them.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Stealing an enemy jungle camp is worth double value -- you gain souls and deny them from the enemy.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Farm backward after pushing a wave to pressure the enemy while you collect souls -- don't overstay though.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't split a trooper wave across more than ~3 teammates -- soul efficiency drops fast.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Shoot soul orbs (yours and theirs) to secure or deny value, both in lane and at Sacrifice events.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Buy up to your unsecured soul total before playing risky, so you don't hand over a big bounty if you die.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Grab boxes and golden statues during lane downtime -- free souls/buffs.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Sacrifice events are high value (extra wave worth + buffs) -- worth contesting or stealing.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't ignore the Soul Urn: deposit faster if you're behind; deny or fight around it if you're ahead.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Solo lane farming (repeatedly shoving/clearing alone) is a legit way for a carry to snowball -- trooper souls scale up significantly when you're farming alone.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: "Priority" (more friendly troopers pushing than enemy) is your window to safely leave lane and jungle-farm.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: If you're solo farming, kill the wave before it crosses into your own territory unless you have an escape route -- dying alone loses your unsecured souls and hands the enemy a big bounty.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Prioritize clearing the wave over finishing a jungle camp if you're running low on time in the cycle.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Solo walkers are worth actively hunting as a carry -- a big, uncontested soul payout.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Green items = Vitality (health, movement, survivability); Orange = Weapon (gun damage/fire rate/ammo); Purple = Spirit (ability damage/cooldowns).
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Items are a personal resource, a team resource, and a toolkit -- counter-build into whoever is dominating the lobby rather than just scaling passively.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Key counter items: Bullet Resist/Metal Skin vs. gun damage, Disarming Hex/Rusted Barrel to shut down a gun-reliant hero, Slowing Hex vs. chasers, Spellbreaker vs. ability burst, Rebuttal vs. parry-able melee kits, Dispel Magic to clear debuffs, Counter Spell to parry abilities, and healing-reduction items (Heal Bane, Crippling Headshot, Inhibitor, Spirit Burn) vs. sustain-heavy heroes.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: A counter item forces the enemy into a bad choice: avoid you, or spend a slot and souls countering your counter -- either way it weakens their build.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: An item's value scales with how many enemies on the other team it counters at once.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Track your investment bars (bottom of the item panel) and try to hit a category's spike threshold (like the 4.8k mark) before the enemy does.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't blindly copy high-win-rate builds -- look for builds from known, trusted community creators, or tweak a template yourself to learn what each item actually does.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Know your character's first major power spike and look to fight around it once you hit it.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Counter-buy based on who's actually winning fights for the enemy team, not just who's ahead on the scoreboard.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Fight when you have a real power spike (a big investment item or a maxed ability) -- try to sync power spikes with teammates.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Win the laning stage first, then use your lead to invade the enemy jungle and gank.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Fight under your own Walkers when you can -- the resistance buff there makes it a safer place to start fights.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Check both teams' ultimate availability (top-of-screen icons) before committing to a fight.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Hold high ground or veils for positional advantage in fights.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Midgame loop: fix your wave -> create time -> move -> take an objective -> reset -> repeat.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Push a wave before starting a fight -- clearing it buys you ~30-45 seconds before it becomes a problem again.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: In late game (25+ min), set up on an aggressively pushed wave and wait for the enemy to respond before engaging.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't jungle while an objective or fight is active elsewhere on the map -- apply pressure or contest it instead.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Track enemy habits over time (who roams, who overextends) -- predictable patterns can be punished.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Use side objectives (Urn, a walker push, Mid Boss) as misdirection to pull enemy attention from where you actually want to play.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Deadlock is a game of trades -- you won't hold every objective forever, so make sure you take something of comparable value back when you lose one.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: If the enemy is heavily committing to one fight/point on the map, look for the opening it creates elsewhere.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Play passive when you're behind on money/numbers/pressure; play aggressive when you're ahead.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Being ahead in kills/souls but still losing is usually a midgame rotation/timing problem, not a mechanics problem.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Take fights with a clear purpose -- not just because a fight is available.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't die trying to save a teammate who made a bad play; if you can't reach them in time, don't force it.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't over-chase kills -- forcing an enemy to retreat and burn respawn/regen time is often just as valuable as the kill.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Track who's used their Rejuvenator (underline indicator under their name) to know who's more killable.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Call and focus one target as a team instead of splitting damage across multiple targets.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Only fight when you have the advantage -- don't force a 1v1 against someone far above you in net worth.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: After winning a fight, immediately capitalize -- take Mid Boss, run the Urn, take an objective, or steal jungle.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't join a fight that's already lost or over -- make impact elsewhere instead (split push, deny an objective).
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Watch the map constantly -- missing enemies on the minimap tell you where the danger is.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Learn hero matchups both ways: know what beats your hero and what your hero beats.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Avoid getting 3+ teammates involved in one kill when possible -- soul splits get punishing past 2 players on a kill.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Focus each session on specific, concrete goals (like objective timing) instead of just chasing wins -- rank follows skill over time.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Accept that you'll lose close to 40% of games no matter how well you play -- sustaining a 60%+ win rate is very hard.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Judge a death by 4 factors: how early it happened (before 20 min matters less), where it happened (enemy side is better than yours), how many enemies were involved (3+ splits their reward), and whether you had unsecured souls on you.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Don't play scared in ranked -- Deadlock rewards aggression, and most early deaths matter less than they feel like they do.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Your teammates aren't the reason you're stuck -- review your own mistakes after a loss.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Mute a tilting teammate rather than let them affect your play.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: After every loss, pick one mistake and focus on fixing just that one thing in your next game.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Improvement comes in small increments -- focus on one thing at a time rather than trying to fix everything at once.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Distinguish a bad idea from bad execution when reviewing a play that didn't work.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: Communicate with simple pings and call-outs before making a play.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

tips.text: If you're the closest player to a lane or a developing problem, it's on you to handle it.
tips.source: Extracted from Dennis's uploaded video transcripts (dl_transcripts.xlsx) + current patch research (Aug 2026)

reading.title: Hero Archetypes
reading.body: Carries are weak early, strong late; Tanks soak damage; Supports enable; Assassins are strong early, fall off late; Brawlers mix carry/tank. Items let you flex any hero into different roles though.

reading.title: Basic Laning Loop
reading.body: Push wave, then shoot the enemy hero, then the neutral creep, then farm boxes/spend money. Heal by returning to base or fighting near your wave's trooper anchor. If losing lane badly, play defensively near your tower and just deny/secure souls.

reading.title: Basic Midgame Rules
reading.body: Constantly check the map. Don't cross the halfway line unless you're ready to die there. Compare relative net worth ("numbers") before committing to a fight. Team fights are mostly about everyone focusing the same target.

reading.title: Current Patch: Ranked/Standard Split (July 30, 2026)
reading.body: Deadlock now has two matchmaking modes: Standard (casual, no rank effect, any party size) and Ranked (seasonal, calibration phase, hero-mastery gate of 60 Standard wins + 15 wins on 3 heroes, pre-game hero-swap phase).

reading.title: Current Patch: Soul Urn Rework
reading.body: The Soul Urn is now its own standalone objective. The runner gets a deposit bounty, souls release as orbs on deposit, and the Urn self-walks toward the deposit point after 3 minutes if unclaimed.

reading.title: Current Patch: Unstable Rift
reading.body: Replaced the old King of the Hill objective. Spawns randomly in a lane roughly every 7 minutes (60s early visual cue, 25s global announcement). Comeback bonuses scale with how far behind a team is; the winning team gets a Rift Trooper wave.
